title: Suspect in Lanao del Norte attacks dies after truck hits him

blocks.text: ILIGAN CITY — A man suspected of killing a woman and wounding three others in separate incidents in Lala, Lanao del Norte, died after he was allegedly hit by a truck while crossing a road, police said. A police report identified the suspect as Mario Polinar, married, a resident of Purok 4A, Barangay Cabasagan in Lala town. At around 10 p.m. on Sunday, Polinar allegedly killed Rose Cahuba, a resident of Kapatagan, Lanao del Norte, by hitting her with a piece of hardwood in Barangay Cabasagan.
